title: Actions related to reception of the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink by the UE

entities.name: UECapabilityEnquirySidelink
entities.description: Message received by the UE that triggers the UE capability information procedure for sidelink communication.

entities.name: UECapabilityInformationSidelink
entities.description: Message constructed by the UE in response to UECapabilityEnquirySidelink, containing UE radio access capabilities for sidelink.

entities.name: UE radio access capabilities for sidelink
entities.description: Information element containing the UE's radio access capabilities specific to sidelink communication.

entities.name: frequencyBandListFilterSidelink
entities.description: Information element received in UECapabilityEnquirySidelink that filters which frequency bands to include in capability reporting.

entities.name: candidate band combinations
entities.description: Temporary list of band combinations compiled by the UE based on frequencyBandListFilterSidelink, prioritized according to the filter order.

entities.name: supportedBandCombinationListSidelinkNR
entities.description: Information element in UECapabilityInformationSidelink containing the actual supported band combinations for sidelink NR.

entities.name: appliedFreqBandListFilter
entities.description: Field in the requested UE capability that includes the received frequencyBandListFilterSidelink.

entities.name: message size constraints
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot include all band combinations due to message size limitations.

entities.name: list size constraints
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot include all band combinations due to list size limitations.

entities.name: UE implementation prioritization
entities.description: Property that allows UE implementation to decide which band combinations to prioritize when constraints prevent including all combinations.

relations.description: UECapabilityInformationSidelink message contains UE radio access capabilities for sidelink.
Candidate band combinations are compiled based on and prioritized according to frequencyBandListFilterSidelink.
Supported band combination list includes band combinations from the candidate band combinations list.
Message size constraints establish that UE implementation decides prioritization of band combinations.
List size constraints establish that UE implementation decides prioritization of band combinations.
